gap.title: Bipartite 4-cycle-free edge circuits with no OR mixing a point and a line have at least |E| + tau - 1 gates
gap.statement:
∀ (p l : ℕ) (E : Finset (Fin p × Fin l)) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
  (∀ (a a' : Fin p) (b b' : Fin l), a ≠ a' → b ≠ b' →
      ¬ ((a, b) ∈ E ∧ (a, b') ∈ E ∧ (a', b) ∈ E ∧ (a', b') ∈ E)) →
  PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (p + l) C →
  (∀ x : Fin (p + l) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (p + l) C x =
      decide (∃ (a : Fin p) (b : Fin l), (a, b) ∈ E ∧ x (Fin.castAdd l a) = true ∧ x (Fin.natAdd p b) = true)) →
  PEqualNP.TwoColour.tCount (p + l) C (fun i => decide (p ≤ i)) = 0 →
  ∃ S : Finset (Fin (p + l)),
    (∀ (a : Fin p) (b : Fin l), (a, b) ∈ E → Fin.castAdd l a ∈ S ∨ Fin.natAdd p b ∈ S) ∧
    E.card + S.card ≤ C.size + 1
gap.unlocks: the size bound for circuits with no OR mixing points and lines; on paper this class costs at most a factor six, so it is the plane question up to a constant
gap.context: SKETCH: No proof is in hand, and none is expected to be short: on paper every circuit off at one-hot inputs equals one of this class of at most six times its size, so this bound is the whole question up to a constant. The class: every OR reaches, through ORs, only points or only lines. Known: one rebuilding move removes a region of ANDs not below F when every gate reading it accepts one star; on our exact circuits that fails at readers accepting a three-edge path or two disjoint edges: price those. Size: open. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.
